architecture.mechanism: Pseudo-two-dimensional phase-field electrochemical model explaining how temperature-dependent kinetic rates and charge transfer resistances govern electrolyte depletion and sensor impedance noise.
architecture.intervention: Implement a temperature-aware threshold filter in the vehicle's Battery Management System (BMS) that dynamically widens the voltage hysteresis band and delays the warning light activation based on real-time coolant temperature.
architecture.expected_effect: The BMS distinguishes transient signal spikes caused by thermal impedance changes from actual battery failures, preventing false-positive warnings during cold starts while preserving protection for warm-up conditions.
architecture.falsification_test: Connect a vehicle to a temperature chamber and record BMS voltage logs at -20C; a correct fix will show the BMS ignoring transient voltage oscillations that would otherwise trigger the warning light.
